== gfdt_dump (the guest FDT the layer would build; no serial number, MAC or seed can appear) ==
// pmlog at 0x844000000, 0x200000 bytes (cut out of /memory)
// guest image at 0x846000000, image end 0x846300000, guest FDT at 0x846300000
// wel2.fb=band: the layer's plan fails (no framebuffer, not whole 16 KB pages, or no room for the band): it keeps the panel, no node
// framebuffer plan (16 KB granule): mode none, band rows 0, guest rows 0, guest base 0x0, guest bytes 0x0
// guest FDT: 2096 bytes (limit 32704), 2 /memory range(s), 8 core(s), wel2.fb=band
/:
  #address-cells = <0x2>;
  #size-cells = <0x2>;
  compatible = "watari,el2-guest";
  memory@844100000:
    device_type = "memory";
    reg = <0x8 0x44100000 0x1 0xbbf00000>;
  memory@800000000:
    device_type = "memory";
    reg = <0x8 0x0 0x0 0x42000000>;
  reserved-memory:
    #address-cells = <0x2>;
    #size-cells = <0x2>;
    ranges;
    pmlog@844000000:
      compatible = "watari,pmlog";
      reg = <0x8 0x44000000 0x0 0x100000>;
      no-map;
  psci:
    compatible = "arm,psci-1.0", "arm,psci-0.2";
    method = "hvc";
  intc@f00000000:
    compatible = "arm,gic-v3";
    interrupt-controller;
    #interrupt-cells = <0x3>;
    reg = <0xf 0x0 0x0 0x10000 0xf 0x10000000 0x0 0x100000>;
    phandle = <0x1>;
  timer:
    compatible = "arm,armv8-timer";
    interrupt-parent = <0x1>;
    interrupts = <0x1 0xd 0x4 0x1 0xe 0x4 0x1 0xb 0x4 0x1 0xa 0x4>;
    always-on;
  cpus:
    #address-cells = <0x2>;
    #size-cells = <0x0>;
    cpu@0:
      device_type = "cpu";

      reg = <0x0 0x0>;

      enable-method = "psci";

== the same guest FDT through dtc ==
/dts-v1/;

/ {
	#address-cells = <0x02>;
	#size-cells = <0x02>;
	compatible = "watari,el2-guest";

	memory@844100000 {
		device_type = "memory";
		reg = <0x08 0x44100000 0x01 0xbbf00000>;
	};

	memory@800000000 {
		device_type = "memory";
		reg = <0x08 0x00 0x00 0x42000000>;
	};

	reserved-memory {
		#address-cells = <0x02>;
		#size-cells = <0x02>;
		ranges;

		pmlog@844000000 {
			compatible = "watari,pmlog";
			reg = <0x08 0x44000000 0x00 0x100000>;
			no-map;
		};
	};

	psci {
		compatible = "arm,psci-1.0", "arm,psci-0.2";
		method = "hvc";
	};

	intc@f00000000 {
		compatible = "arm,gic-v3";
		interrupt-controller;
		#interrupt-cells = <0x03>;
		reg = <0x0f 0x00 0x00 0x10000 0x0f 0x10000000 0x00 0x100000>;
		phandle = <0x01>;
	};

	timer {
		compatible = "arm,armv8-timer";
		interrupt-parent = <0x01>;
		interrupts = <0x01 0x0d 0x04 0x01 0x0e 0x04 0x01 0x0b 0x04 0x01 0x0a 0x04>;
		always-on;
	};

	cpus {
		#address-cells = <0x02>;
		#size-cells = <0x00>;

		cpu@0 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x00>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@1 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x01>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@2 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x02>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@3 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x03>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@10100 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x10100>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@10101 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x10101>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@10102 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x10102>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@10103 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x10103>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};
	};

	chosen {

		watari,el2 {
			compatible = "watari,el2";
			version = <0x01>;
			platform = "t8103";
			hvc-vendor-base = <0xc6000000>;
			gicd-base = <0x0f 0x00>;
			gicr-base = <0x0f 0x10000000>;
			gicr-stride = <0x20000>;
			msi-frame-base = <0x00 0xfffff000>;
			fb-mode = "none";
		};
	};
